answer: Each identity locks a 400,000 POA bond into the harbor vault at registration, and the vault issues one tide receipt per bond. At payout, the tide audit matches every receipt against the harbor ledger: two identities sharing one tide lose both bonds, their rewards flow to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
